provenance.steps: The point-in-time view at origin t keeps register rows with origination_date <= t and panel rows with as_of_date <= t. views: hand count of the DATA-PIT-01 events fixture at each month end of its window (loans originated 2023-06-15 for F1, P1, M1, D1, S1 and R1, 2024-02-10 for R2 and 2024-03-05 for N1; 6, 7, 4 and 3 panel rows at the four month ends). Property: for each origin, each trial applies one to three random changes to information after the origin (edit a field of a later panel row or of the register row of a later loan, move a later panel row to another later month end, delete a later row, add a later row for a new loan) and requires the view at the origin to be unchanged. Negative control: the same changes without the filter always change the data.
